name: scw-events-to-workflowers-block-peter

deploy.description: Peter's copy of scw-events-to-workflowers-block. One half of the two-way calendar-blocking pair for Peter's calendars (with workflowers-events-to-scw-busy-peter; gcal-block-sweep-peter is the horizon backstop). Mirrors every timed, busy, non-declined event on the pgao@securecodewarrior.com Google Calendar onto peter@work.flowers WITH ITS FULL TITLE, keyed through Peter's own GCal Sync Map table so updates move/rename the block and cancellations delete it. Refuses to create a mirror for an occurrence starting more than 30 days out (expand_recurring fires an open-ended series ~14 years ahead); the sweep fills those in as they approach. ONE DELIBERATE DEVIATION from Dennis's copy (Peter, 2026-09-15): SCW events whose Google eventType is focusTime, outOfOffice or workingLocation (Focus time, Out of office, 'Unavailable on Fridays', 'Home') are never mirrored, and an existing mirror is deleted if its source turns into one of those types.

trigger.authentication_note: Peter's SCW Google Calendar connection ('pgao@securecodewarrior.com'). The credential for the calendar being READ lives here on the trigger; Peter's work.flowers credential is a --connections alias because the workflow writes there. Never Dennis's SCW connection (02cb5353-8bd1-82ad-a382-b1900d3d40f2).
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger, fires on create AND update — but in practice only ever once per occurrence (Zapier durables dedupe on the raw event id; ticket W6ZE93-VMEWP), so every later change is propagated by gcal-block-sweep-peter's daily reconcile pass. Cancellations DO NOT arrive through it: with expand_recurring: true Zapier silently drops cancelled tombstones (proven on Dennis's pair 2026-08-31). Deletion propagation lives in scw-cancellations-to-workflowers-unblock-peter (event_cancelled). The cancel branch in this workflow is kept as a belt.
trigger.params_note: expand_recurring: true because blocking needs one mirror per occurrence, keyed on the occurrence id. A weekly series expands ~14 years (730 instances) in one poll — the workflow's 30-day horizon guard is what makes this affordable. selected_api pinned at 1.16.0, the version Zapier served at authoring time (2026-09-15); Dennis's originals still carry 1.15.0.

connections_note: gcal_wf is Peter's work.flowers Google Calendar connection ('peter@work.flowers') — the DESTINATION this workflow creates/updates/deletes mirror events on. Never Dennis's work.flowers connection (02a752ba-ba43-86d2-b9f7-dc031d6d1aa5).
sharing_note: Peter's connections (02b0ea0a-… work.flowers, 02edd3ce-… SCW) and the GCal Sync Map (Peter) table 01M2HT9XPZEASFV09J4A3QTDGT are owned by Peter's own Zapier profile, not the CI identity. The publish pipeline's CI identity must be able to use all three, so they are shared with the work.flowers account before merge — see gcal-block-sweep-peter/README.md. Shared on: 2026-09-25.

tables.01M2HT9XPZEASFV09J4A3QTDGT: GCal Sync Map (Peter) — source occurrence id -> mirror event id, both directions. SHARED with workflowers-events-to-scw-busy-peter, the two -cancellations- companions and gcal-block-sweep-peter, and with NOTHING of Dennis's: a table shared across the two people would cross-contaminate loop guards and mirror maps. Same 8-column schema as Dennis's GCal Sync Map: Source Event ID (f1), Mirror Event ID (f2), Direction (f3, scw_to_wf|wf_to_scw), Status (f4, active|deleted), Start (f5), End (f6), Summary (f7), Source Updated (f8).
